::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Joshua records Israel's conquest and settlement of the Promised Land, demonstrating that God faithfully fulfills His promises. The book teaches that victory comes through trusting and obeying the Lord. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Joshua 1:9
Be strong and courageous
### Why This Verse Most famous verse in Joshua ### Chapter Insight This chapter commissions Joshua to lead Israel into the Promised Land. The key verse emphasizes courage grounded in God's presence and promises. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Joshua 2:11
The LORD your God is God
### Why This Verse Rahab's confession of faith ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Rahab's protection of the spies. The key verse highlights faith that recognizes God's sovereignty. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Joshua 3:5
Sanctify yourselves
### Why This Verse Preparation for crossing Jordan ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Israel's crossing of the Jordan River. The key verse demonstrates God's power and presence leading His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Joshua 4:24
That all peoples may know the LORD
### Why This Verse Purpose of the memorial stones ### Chapter Insight This chapter establishes memorial stones to remember God's faithfulness. The key verse emphasizes passing God's works to future generations. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Joshua 5:14
Captain of the LORD's host
### Why This Verse Significant theophany passage ### Chapter Insight This chapter marks Israel's renewal through circumcision and Passover. The key verse reveals God's removal of Israel's reproach and preparation for conquest. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Joshua 6:20
The wall fell down flat
### Why This Verse Famous Jericho victory verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the fall of Jericho. The key verse highlights victory through obedience rather than human strength. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Joshua 7:13
Israel hath sinned
### Why This Verse Explanation of Israel's defeat ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Achan's sin and Israel's defeat at Ai. The key verse demonstrates how hidden sin affects the entire community. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Joshua 8:1
Fear not, neither be dismayed
### Why This Verse Restoration after failure ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Israel's victory at Ai and covenant renewal. The key verse emphasizes obedience as the path to success. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Joshua 9:14
Asked not counsel at the mouth of the LORD
### Why This Verse Lesson from the Gibeonite deception ### Chapter Insight This chapter tells of the Gibeonites' deception. The key verse illustrates the danger of making decisions without seeking God's counsel. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Joshua 10:13
The sun stood still
### Why This Verse One of the Bible's best-known miracles ### Chapter Insight This chapter records God's miraculous intervention in battle. The key verse highlights God's power fighting on behalf of His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Joshua 11:15
Joshua left nothing undone
### Why This Verse Summary of Joshua's obedience ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the defeat of northern Canaanite kings. The key verse emphasizes God's faithfulness in fulfilling His promises. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Joshua 12:24
Thirty-one kings in all
### Why This Verse Summary of conquest victories ### Chapter Insight This chapter summarizes Israel's military victories. The key verse reflects God's complete victory over opposing kings. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Joshua 13:1
Thou art old and stricken in years
### Why This Verse Transition to land distribution ### Chapter Insight This chapter begins the division of the land among the tribes. The key verse reminds Joshua that God's work continues despite his age. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Joshua 14:12
Give me this mountain
### Why This Verse Caleb's famous request ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Caleb's request for his inheritance. The key verse highlights steadfast faith after decades of waiting. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
Joshua 15:19
Give me a blessing
### Why This Verse Achsah's request for springs ### Chapter Insight This chapter details Judah's inheritance. The key verse emphasizes the fulfillment of God's promise to Caleb. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
Joshua 16:10
They did not drive out the Canaanites
### Why This Verse Foreshadows future problems ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the inheritance of Ephraim. The key verse highlights God's faithfulness in distributing the land. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
Joshua 17:18
Thou shalt drive out the Canaanites
### Why This Verse Call to faith and action ### Chapter Insight This chapter details the inheritance of Manasseh. The key verse demonstrates faith in claiming God's promises. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
Joshua 18:3
How long are ye slack to possess the land?
### Why This Verse Challenge to incomplete obedience ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues the distribution of the land. The key verse challenges Israel to fully possess what God has given. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
Joshua 19:49
They made an inheritance for Joshua
### Why This Verse Joshua receives his portion ### Chapter Insight This chapter completes the tribal inheritances. The key verse demonstrates God's faithfulness to all the tribes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
Joshua 20:3
Cities of refuge
### Why This Verse Purpose statement for refuge cities ### Chapter Insight This chapter establishes the cities of refuge. The key verse reveals God's provision of justice and mercy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
Joshua 21:45
Not one promise failed
### Why This Verse One of Joshua's most quoted verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter assigns cities to the Levites. The key verse celebrates God's complete fulfillment of His promises. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
Joshua 22:5
Love the LORD and walk in His ways
### Why This Verse Covenant exhortation ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the eastern tribes' return home. The key verse emphasizes unity and faithfulness within God's people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
Joshua 23:14
Not one thing hath failed
### Why This Verse Joshua's farewell testimony ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Joshua's farewell exhortation. The key verse calls Israel to remain devoted to God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
Joshua 24:15
As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD
### Why This Verse One of the most cited verses in Scripture ### Chapter Insight This chapter concludes with covenant renewal at Shechem. The key verse challenges God's people to choose whom they will serve. :::
